item: The terminal panel's launcher test records whether each held variable reached the panel, never its value
summary: Follow-up found by the security reads of PR #1847. The stand-in python in tests/test_terminal_panel.py::_tree_with_panel echoed the values of OO_DB_PASSPHRASE and OO_KEY_PASSPHRASE into a file (panel.args) to prove the panel never received them: a line that held only dummy values and stayed empty unless launch.sh regressed, but the shape the passphrase rule forbids (no secret into a file), and on a regression it would have written whatever the run held. It now writes one held:NAME=set|unset line per name in OO_TEST_PRESENCE_NAMES, handed over in the environment so no name is written into the script either, with OO_TEST_PANEL_ARGS as a control that must read set. Mutation-checked: dropping one name from launch.sh's env -u list fails the test on that name. Test-only; no shipped behaviour changes.
